title: Normalize the selected complex layer and perform its single toward-zero return with a literal 18-tape program
body:
## Exact scoped result
One fixed 18-tape program implements the selected complex-layer normalization and final toward-zero projection, including staged commit, tail cleanup and head return. Independent arithmetic and execution checks passed. Credits #3127.

## Verification and limitations
Canonical base e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. Mathematical proof, reproduction commands, independent or separate checks and negative controls are in the package. No new complete kappa: the selected bound remains conditional on all five foundational assumptions. This scoped enabling result is not an unconditional multiplication theorem.

## Credit and further detail
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors. Full proof and detailed PR description: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/51ab0539059214fcfa044938c36a0b6017232be5/research/literal-layer-egress
